companyDescription: Extended-release local steroid (Diffusphere™) · EP-104GI, a single-procedure esophageal injection for eosinophilic esophagitis — Phase 2b RESOLVE placebo-controlled interim due December 2026
priceNote: Live $6.43 (-2.87%) on Nov 18, 2026 (live-prices cache) — -16% since the Nov 11 report ($7.63). No company news was found since then; the move tracks the small-cap biotech selloff into the Nov 17 S&P five-month low.
summary: Refresh (no thesis change, -16% on the tape): no Eupraxia news was found since Nov 11. The thesis remains the placebo-controlled RESOLVE Phase 2b interim for EP-104GI (single-procedure Diffusphere steroid injection for EoE), expected December 2026, after open-label high-dose cohorts showed 66% clinical remission at 36 weeks (Apr 2026). The drop to $6.43 is sector-driven. Base is trimmed to $11.25 (+75%) against the turbo Base bias (+52.5pp vs realized 30d P75 +21.5%); the Bull/Moon targets ($17.17 consensus, $25 Stifel) are unchanged. The turbo at-catalyst median is -6.6% (n=76), so Entry 2 is preferred. แนะนำ 2–3% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า RESOLVE interim พลาด ลงได้ 45–55%.

catalysts.name: RESOLVE Phase 2b interim (placebo-controlled) — EP-104GI in EoE
catalysts.description: 120 patients (120mg / 160mg / vehicle, 1:1:1), enrollment complete Oct 12, 2026. Company reconfirmed a December 2026 interim in its Nov 10 Q3 release. Histology plus symptom (dysphagia) separation vs vehicle is the bar.

risks: EoE trials can hit histology and still miss symptoms. Allakos hit its histologic co-primaries but missed the symptom endpoints and fell ~88% (Dec 2021).
A new US$125M ATM (Nov 10) gives the company a way to sell into any pre-data strength.
The open-label Phase 1b/2a cohorts were tiny (the high-dose group was n=3), so placebo-controlled data may shrink the effect.
Competitive market: Dupixent is entrenched in EoE, and oral and biologic entrants keep raising the bar.
"December" has no exact day, and an interim (not final) readout invites a "wait for full data" discount.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00% after the Sep 16 hike. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~95% (Nov 17–18), with the remainder on 50bp. Waller has floated 50bp; Williams pushed back.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI ran hot (core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2%). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Clinical-stage GI biotech. The RESOLVE interim dominates. Rates matter through small-cap biotech multiples and the ATM sale price.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — macro is WAIT (30/100): the S&P closed Nov 17 on its 200-day at a 5-month low with VIX ~23–26. The outcome here is idiosyncratic, but small-cap biotech sells first on a hot PCE, so use the dip entry.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE · ค่าขนม 2.5% max — unchanged thesis, cheaper entry ahead of the December placebo-controlled interim. The measured turbo at-catalyst median is -6.6% (n=76), so Entry 2 ($5.80–6.20) is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: EPRX popped +11% on Nov 11 after Q3 reconfirmed the December timing. Small caps with a dated controlled readout often drift up into it, but the ATM will supply stock into strength.

postWin.note: MDGL rose ~268% in a day on a clean Phase 3 (Dec 2022), the top-decile shape. A Phase 2b interim on a mid-size indication more realistically re-rates +30–100% toward the ~$17 consensus.

postLose.note: ALLK fell ~88% when its EoE program hit histology but missed symptoms (Dec 2021). CMPS fell ~36% on a technically positive but underwhelming Phase 3 (Jun 2025).

spotSizing.reason: 2.5%. phase3_readout has no n≥5 turbo bucket (context only). Lane-wide prior (hitRate 6.5%, softHitRate 27.1%, beatBench 71%, n=107) and a WAIT macro tape (30/100) keep turbo sizing at the low end of 2–5%.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the turbo medianMAE (-20%). A break below ~$4.85 before the event means the market is pricing a bad outcome.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If either dose fails to separate on symptoms, exit day 1 (ALLK precedent).

comparableCases.note: Upper-bound template for a clean controlled win in a depressed small/mid-cap. Treat it as the Moon shape, not the base.
The open-label data barely moved the stock (~+5%). The market is waiting for placebo control, which is why the December interim is the real binary.

th.summary: รีเฟรช (thesis ไม่เปลี่ยน ลง 16% ตามตลาด): ไม่พบข่าว Eupraxia ใหม่ตั้งแต่ 11 พ.ย. thesis ยังเป็นผลระหว่างทางของ RESOLVE Phase 2b แบบมีกลุ่มยาหลอกของ EP-104GI (ยาสเตียรอยด์ Diffusphere ฉีดครั้งเดียวสำหรับ EoE) คาดออก ธ.ค. 2026 หลังกลุ่มขนาดสูงแบบ open-label ให้ clinical remission 66% ที่ 36 สัปดาห์ (เม.ย. 2026) การลงมาที่ $6.43 เป็นเรื่องของกลุ่ม ปรับ Base ลงเป็น $11.25 (+75%) ตาม bias ของ Base ใน turbo (+52.5pp เทียบ P75 30 วันจริง +21.5%) เป้า Bull/Moon ($17.17 เป้าเฉลี่ย, $25 Stifel) เท่าเดิม median ถึงวัน catalyst ของ turbo -6.6% (n=76) จึงเข้าที่ Entry 2 เป็นหลัก แนะนำ 2–3% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้าผล RESOLVE พลาด ลงได้ 45–55%
th.priceNote: ราคาสด $6.43 (-2.87%) 18 พ.ย. 2026 ลง 16% จากรายงาน 11 พ.ย. ($7.63) ไม่พบข่าวบริษัทตั้งแต่นั้น การลงตามการเทขายไบโอเทคเล็กพร้อมที่ S&P ทำจุดต่ำสุดรอบ 5 เดือน 17 พ.ย.
